footnote_text: Represents the remaining ordinary shares of the Issuer, par value $0.001 per share, beneficially owned by the reporting person following the reported transaction, which underlie restricted stock units ("RSUs") granted on November 1, 2025. The remaining RSUs will vest in two equal annual installments on November 1, 2027 and November 1, 2028, subject to the reporting person's continued service through each applicable vesting date. Each RSU represents a contingent right to receive one Ordinary Share.
